title: TokenCountRequest
description: POST /v1/tokenize on the Stack (STACK-TOKENIZE-01): the chat engine's own token count. Send exactly one of `messages` (rendered with the engine's own chat template, no generation prompt, then tokenized; `tools` and `chat_template_kwargs` render into the prompt and are counted when sent) or `content` (a raw string, tokenized as given). `model` names a chat-wire role (`chat`, `coding`, `judge`, `router`, `vision`) or an installed chat model id. An image part counts as the template's media marker only.
